This classic Elkton model home built in 2003 by Toll Brothers in Devon Farms Community is located on a great corner level lot overlooking luscious green landscaping with mature specimen trees. Impressive double height entry foyer welcomes you into this beautiful colonial featuring an open floor plan. The large kitchen will definitely live up to your standards with Silestone counters and island, stainless appliances and deep pantry. The adjoining two story family room can double as a conservatory for the music lover. The large deck off the kitchen is a great spot to entertain or take in the sun. This large property also offers you a possible place for your future pool. The full height basement can be finished in the future for an additional 1500 square feet of living space. With so many wonderful features this home can fulfill all your needs and more!.
